top_signals.title: Sweetgreen CEO Says Cyclospora Hurt Sales
top_signals.summary: Sweetgreen Inc. CEO Jonathan Neman says the cyclospora outbreak had an impact on the business but the US FDA now says it's safe to eat iceberg lettuce again. He says Sweetgreen's supply chain isn’t affected by the cyclospora outbreak and its restaurants don’t serve that kind of lettuce. Neman speaks to Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Ancora Comfortable With Its Offer for H.B. Fuller Unit
top_signals.summary: Ancora Holdings Group is pushing to acquire H.B. Fuller Co.'s building adhesives unit for as much as $1.2 billion. James Chadwick is the president of Ancora's alternatives arm. He says the activist investor is comfortable with the offer and it would be a "win-win" for shareholders. He speaks on "Bloomberg Deals." (Source: Bloomberg)
